changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.sql: WITH extracted AS ( SELECT p.id AS provider_id, upper(profile_entry.key) AS professional_profile_code, field_entry.key AS field_key, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(field_entry.value) = 'array' THEN ( SELECT string_agg(array_value, '||') FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(field_entry.value) AS array_value ) WHEN jsonb_typeof(field_entry.value) = 'string' THEN field_entry.value #>> '{}' WHEN jsonb_typeof(field_entry.value) = 'null' THEN NULL ELSE field_entry.value::text END AS field_value, 1 AS sys_user_id FROM clinlims.provider p CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(p.profile_fields_json), ''), '{}')::jsonb) AS profile_entry CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(profile_entry.value) AS field_entry WHERE NULLIF(trim(p.profile_fields_json), '') IS NOT NULL ) INSERT INTO clinlims.provider_profile_field_value ( id, provider_id, professional_profile_code, field_key, field_value, sys_user_id, lastupdated ) SELECT nextval('clinlims.provider_profile_field_value_seq'), extracted.provider_id, extracted.professional_profile_code, extracted.field_key, extracted.field_value, extracted.sys_user_id, ${now} FROM extracted WHERE extracted.field_value IS NOT NULL AND btrim(extracted.field_value) <> '' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.provider_profile_field_value existing WHERE existing.provider_id = extracted.provider_id AND existing.professional_profile_code = extracted.professional_profile_code AND existing.field_key = extracted.field_key );
